meta.title: Rukh · lab
meta.description: A hands-on course on generative and agentic AI that builds a chess language model from scratch: data, decoder, encoder, fine-tuning, alignment with verifiable rewards, RAG and agents.

landing.title: A chess language model, from scratch.
landing.lead: Thirteen modules building a single project: a GPT that learns to play by reading games, gets aligned with rewards a chess engine can verify, runs in your browser and ends up as a coaching agent with tools. The lessons are written in Spanish.
landing.whyTitle: A closed domain, open data, small models.

why.title: Verifiable
why.body: Move legality and quality are decided by an engine, not a person. That makes reward models, DPO and GRPO possible with real, cheap rewards.

why.title: Open
why.body: Lichess publishes billions of games, puzzles and evaluations under CC0. Nothing to negotiate, nothing to hide about where the data comes from.

why.title: Small
why.body: Tens of millions of parameters: trains in hours on a single GPU and fits in the browser. Everything can be measured and published.

landing.mapLead: Every module improves the same model or adds a piece that uses it. Your progress is stored in this browser.
landing.phase1: Phase 1 · A chess language model from scratch
landing.playTitle: Play against what gets trained here.
landing.playLead: A board, the model panel and the move list. In this first milestone the opponent is "first legal move"; from module 2 on, the decoder trained in the course.

project.title: Rukh, on one page.
project.lead: Rukh is a chess language model trained from scratch, aligned with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, deployed on WebGPU and turned into an agent with tools. This site is the course that documents every step.

what.title: What it is
what.body: A custom decoder (tens of millions of parameters) trained on Lichess games, an encoder that understands positions, instruction-style fine-tuning with target-Elo tokens, a reward model, DPO and GRPO with Stockfish as the judge, ONNX export to play in the browser and, in the second phase, RAG and agents that comment games.
